derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as G3795 (ὀψάριον);
def: rations for a soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay

occurrences.text: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?
I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
